svg.title: Chicorée — Cichorium intybus
svg.desc: A wild chicory specimen with a long cream-brown tapering taproot, deeply backward-lobed basal leaves, wiry branching flowering stems and three open dusty blue composite flowerheads. Each narrow blue ligule has five small teeth and fine parallel veins; little pointed involucres, buds and slender stem leaves show the plant's airy habit.
